svg.title: TOPAK F1 — The model enters as a Persona: a pinned identity, a split lift, and a lineage computed from the log
svg.desc: ADR-0016 to ADR-0020 (Accepted (genesis) 2026.09.12) pin the one component that was a name: the Persona binds a model to its whole runtime configuration, is a verified Build artifact and a lease field. Since Batch 34 a person who acts under a key has a Persona too, with a declared lineage rooted in an identity provider (ADR-0016 A1, A2: in force, provisional with ADR-0050 and ADR-0052). ADR-0035 (Proposed, not in force, revised to R7) would make lineage a projection of the Build log and independence an exclusion rule over two projections. Boundary B8: Persona / occupant identity.
svg.text: TOPAK · F1

text.tspan: The model enters as a Persona: a pinned identity, a split lift, and a lineage computed from the log

svg.text: ADR-0016 to ADR-0020 (Accepted (genesis) 2026.09.12) pin the one component that was a name: the Persona binds a model to its whole runtime configuration, is a verified Build artifact and a lease field. Since Batch 34 a person who acts under a key has a Persona too, with a declared lineage rooted in an identity provider (ADR-0016 A1, A2: in force, provisional with ADR-0050 and ADR-0052). ADR-0035 (Proposed, not in force,
revised to R7) would make lineage a projection of the Build log and independence an exclusion rule over two projections. Boundary B8: Persona / occupant identity.

text.tspan: Accepted · ADR-0018 in part: Reader scope reversed by ADR-0037 §3
Accepted · ADR-0017: ordering-primacy reversed in effect by ADR-0023, supersession unwritten
Accepted · provisional · ADR-0016 A1, A2 · B34: a person's Persona, with ADR-0050 and 0052
Proposed · ADR-0035 lineage, R7, C4 on ratification
ADR-0016 §1 · A Persona binds, at minimum

svg.text: Training corpora identifiers, base-model ancestry, fine-tune chain. Degrades across rungs (ADR-0017). Under ADR-0035 (Proposed): the digest of a projected lineage record
Cryptographically signed by the Build promotion key; the signature is over the whole record, not the model alone
Monotonically increasing per Persona line. Ordering only, not the floor/bundle authority-monotonicity
Byte-exact, hashed
Temperature, top-k, top-p, penalties, stop sequences
The sampler implementation: identical weights under a different sampler is a different Persona
Reproducible, seeded-reproducible or non-reproducible. Inventory and incident context; not an admission precondition (ADR-0020)
An unpinned truncation rule silently changes what the Thinker saw
Identifier and hash of the model-specific emission decoder shipped with this Persona (ADR-0018)
none | topk_logprobs. Optional, rung-gated; non-default only within ADR-0019's narrow scope (§9)
Since ADR-0037 §2 (B12): thinker and observer. The Listener and the Reader are stages and bind no Persona. Since B34: operator (A1) and emergency (A2), for a person's Persona
The artifact is what it claims to be: signature, hash, provenance chain, record completeness. Decidable.

text.tspan: TOPAK verifies Personas. It does not verify models.

svg.text: Evaluations, benchmarks, red-team findings: statistical, no safety property.
A passing evaluation can never admit a Persona; a failing one can deny or quarantine it (ADR-0007).

text.tspan: Accepted · provisional · B34; in force with ADR-0050, ADR-0052

svg.text: A principal who is a person and acts under a key has a Persona record: a signing key, a role, a domain, a
lineage, a Persona ID and a sequence number. No prompt, decoding parameters, decoder or weights; the
table's rows for those do not apply.
Its lineage is declared, and its root is the identity provider that vouches for the person (ADR-0035 §1 R7,
Proposed). Seat binding gains operator.
§6 holds of it: attested at grant and renewal by a sign-on assertion naming the key and the fence. §7 holds of
it: revoking it is an ordinary deny, and a revoked operator can no longer deny.
A2: Seat binding gains emergency (ADR-0052 §1), for a person's Persona attested at the lease boundary by
the break-glass roster's quorum.

text.tspan: At the reference: an operator's Persona is its seat's key
Not built · the record and the lineage

svg.text: No Persona record for a person and no lineage (ADR-0045 Annex B, A2; mechanism/ I47): T-0045-36's
instance is the seat's key, with no record behind it, and nothing compares two operators' providers (T-0045-35;
D-0050-2 is not told from the archetype).
A sign-on assertion is read at an operator's lease boundary under a provider key the rules issue (I47).
An operator's Persona record and lineage are part of ADR-0050's exit from provisional (G10 §7 item 88), with
a first lease from a quorum; a first seating is the BOOTSTRAP socket (D-0050-1 for that step).

text.tspan: The Persona's path: a Build artifact, admitted per seat, carried in the lease

svg.text: Every parameter change is a new Persona and a new promotion: temperature is a deploy-cadence change.
Imported models pass the same gate; provenance degrades, the gate does not: verified → attested → asserted (§4).

text.tspan: Bundle policy admits Personas per seat (§5)

svg.text: Seat distinctness: the Observer's Persona differs from the Thinker's by lineage, not configuration; since ADR-0037 one (thinker, observer) pair per cell. Enforcement moves to the tally and declaration (ADR-0035 §5, finding
Floor bound: the floor names admissible Persona classes; bundles only subtract.

text.tspan: The lease carries the Persona ID (§6)

svg.text: Attested at grant and at renewal; unattestable means deny, and the principal is evicted by the passive path.

ttl ≤ T_persona (ADR-0031 A2), refused at grant and renewal at the reference since ADR-0033 A6 (I35). Expiry runs on the local clock, so the interval is T_persona plus drift (ADR-0045 finding 2; G10 §7 item 62).
Local, no consensus, no floor exception; not an ADR-0013 carve-out. A revoked Persona's leases end, it is barred from later grants, and no other round stops.

text.tspan: B8 in the boundary register (09.13) and since

svg.text: As registered: outer cadence Provider (uncontrolled) / Persona promotion; instant: Persona promotion only; interval of untruth unbounded (no expiry, no re-attestation); behaviour when unavailable undefined. "The largest empty
cell in the grid" (ToO §10: the most critical boundary).
Since: model change has an event (lease attestation catches a declared change, ADR-0019 drift an undeclared one); the interval is bounded by T_persona on the value, not on the clock.

text.tspan: At the reference: no Persona record, a
Not built · the record proper; the stand-in is built

svg.text: The reference has none of §1's fields. Its Persona is a model.json bundle, {family, params, weights, weights_sha256}, whose id is the SHA-256 of the file's bytes (topak-contain; slm/). Rules.personas maps that
digest to an ADR-0017 provenance (in_house_pretrain, in_house_finetune, attested_external, asserted_external) and is empty in dev.

For an operator grant persona is an operator-supplied digest, checked against nothing (G13); a launch checks the guest's reported digest against the profile's, which is all a rung detects. ttl ≤ T_persona is the one rule of §6
the code enforces (inventory §1.6).

text.tspan: ADR-0018 · The typed lift splits: the decoder ships in the Persona, the validator stays in the mechanism

svg.text: The occupant, under its Persona.
Cognitive payload. Retained in the round topic at the
archetype (ADR-0037; D-0037-2 is its absence).
In the Persona. Owner Persona, cadence Persona promotion,
model-specific, not trusted: a hostile decoder cannot produce an
inadmissible action.
Control plane, if it validates.
In the mechanism. Owner Contain, cadence release,
model-agnostic, trusted: total over the floor's action alphabet, verified
once.
Side channel, optional
Decoding attestation: may admit (ADR-0019)
Cognitive payload
None: it is the decoder's input
Control plane
Boundary event; may admit
Cognitive
Deny-only, per ADR-0007

text.tspan: What the split buys, and what it concedes

svg.text: Adding a model family is a Persona promotion, not a mechanism release: the verified object never learns any model's output format (the ADR-0010 move, applied to syntax).

The validator guarantees admissibility, not fidelity: a decoder can turn “read A” into “read B”, both within policy. The record keeps "this principal emitted admissible action Y" and loses "the model meant X": ADR-0020's concession from
a second direction.
Reader scope correction reversed in effect by ADR-0037 §3 (C3): the Reader is a stage, not a seat, with no Persona; two bullets struck (B12). The split itself stands.
Open: decoder–alphabet compatibility across floor changes (G10 §7 item 17).
decode_observability: topk_logprobs, rung-gated, for decoding attestation, not introspection. none is the only unconditional value (ADR-0016
Decoding conformance: sampled token + distribution + declared parameters is a decidable predicate, the only new admitting check. Since ADR-0037 §3 it
may admit only where inference is attested (rung 3, T-0045-21, T-0045-26: no theorem cites them yet).
Substitution detection: distributional drift catches an undeclared model change. A threshold on drift is semantic: deny-only.
Top-k, not full logits; not in round topics (cognitive payload; storage is ADR-0006's question). Never cited for any claim about L.

text.tspan: ADR-0020 · Replay reconstructs what crossed the membrane

svg.text: The replayable record: actions attempted including denied ones, effects emitted, lease and epoch transitions, the Persona binding in force.
Scratchpads, chains of thought and token traces are out of scope and not written to round topics.
The Observer and replay read the same stream, so L is not measured against hindsight.
The cost: root-cause analysis establishes what a principal did, never why. Revisit triggers: a demand to attribute intent; a detection strategy needing
pre-effect cognitive signal; ADR-0013's forensic floor.

text.tspan: ADR-0017 · The archetype admits only in-house pre-trained Personas

svg.text: Two independent lineages at the archetype, with separate corpora and architecture ancestry: a single lineage reproduces the monoculture blind spot
inside the rung meant to sacrifice nothing.
External model implies Mediated: prompt egress is an out-of-band effect, so effect exclusivity is false by construction (derived, not asserted).
Ratified with its criterion outstanding: until a decidable or auditable independence criterion exists, the archetype may be described but no deployment
may be declared at archetype rung. ADR-0035 writes it, and is Proposed (G10 §7 item 20).
In-house pre-train, two independent lineages
In-house fine-tune on external base
Contained, with a lineage debt stated
Attested external: provider signs a version statement
Asserted external: endpoint and version string only

text.tspan: This table's ordering is no longer the deployment axis

svg.text: Ordering-primacy reversed in effect by ADR-0023 §5 (C3): rungs are per-axis, and provenance is one axis among many. The admission clause stands; the superseding record is unwritten (G10 §7 items 6, 50; ToO §8.3).
Numbers here ascend with weakness and the archetype is unnumbered; confinement rungs ascend with strength. Always qualify "rung" (ToO §8.2).
ADR-0035 adds a second route to rung 1: distillation, in-house weights on generated content (finding 2).

text.tspan: Proposed · 2026.09.25, revised R1–R7; not in force; R2's bound marked for independent review (G10 §7 item 33); R5 to R7 written for ADR-0047, 0048 and 0050
Lineage is projected from the Build log, never authored (§1, §2)

GPT-4). generatedBy declared at corpus admission.

declared at admission.

rung = the lowest confinement rung over every round in the DAG: a lineage is only as strong as its weakest round. A round is ingress-bounded only at rung ≥ 1 on an Attested verdict under a profile meeting ADR-0034 P1 and P2, with every tool it invokes inside the guest (R1, R4); any other round makes the whole record declared (D-0035-1). Until ADR-0034 is in force for such rounds, every

The rehearsal's record, topak.lineage/0 (slm/lineage/record.py), carries these ten fields and adds weight_ancestry, ingress_bytes, consumed_bytes, generated_share, generated_bytes, trainer = {tool, config, seed} and a strength of projected or declared, which drops to declared at rung 0 or under a declared parent (inventory §1.7, §8).

text.tspan: §2 · Every share is an upper bound (R2)

svg.text: Ingress enters only numerators; the denominator is the smaller consumed set. Adding ingress can turn a pass
into a fail, never a fail into a pass.
As first drafted the shares were of ingress and the claim was false: 13 of 2,000 E3 fails and 241 of 2,000
distillation fails turned into passes by adding ingress (finding 5).
The relation is symmetric, irreflexive and not transitive: every seat pair is checked on its own.

text.tspan: §3 · θ are policy-floor values, not yet set

svg.text: θ_exact, θ_near, θ_gen, β and the near-duplicate tool's digest live in floor/genesis-values.json (R3) and
are null: the independence table is not computed while any is null.
Relaxing one is an issuance and a promotion; tightening, an ordinary promotion.
Set from measurements at training scale, not before (G10 §7 item 30). Gate tools would be trust root T-0045-15,
cited by no theorem until ratification.
Three field sets, not one: the floor's lineage block has θ_exact, θ_near, θ_gen, β and near_tool; the
rehearsal's slm/lineage/thresholds.example.json has the three θ, byte thresholds and a granularity,
no β, and non-null numbers marked PLACEHOLDER; the gate suite hard-codes a third (inventory finding 15).

text.tspan: §4, §5 · Computed at the gate; enforced where refusal stalls

svg.text: The gate recomputes each record from the log, checks the authored manifest (divergence = Contested,
attributed), evaluates E1–E5, and emits an independence table, a promoted artifact. The admit path only looks
up a pair of digests.
At the promotion tally (Build): at least one veto seat leased with a Persona independent of the author's, or the
promotion stalls.
At the deployment declaration: archetype provenance only if every (Thinker, Observer) pair is in the table as
projected.
Never at grant: refusing an Observer's lease leaves an empty seat, which vetoes nothing and adds authority to
the author. Run has no tally: declaration only.

text.tspan: §6, §7 · What only subtracts, and what is outside

svg.text: Correlated-miss test: a pair fails when its joint miss rate exceeds β times the product of individual rates; a
failure removes the pair; a pass grants nothing.
Declared residuals: unlabeled model text in crawls; shared human feedback (no feedback field); shared priors
below dedup granularity; a shared training stack (MLX on Apple silicon); reading more than is trained on
(padding).
Structural independence does not imply uncorrelated failures; detection carries no safety theorem.

text.tspan: §1 R5 · An item delivered as a handle is

svg.text: ADR-0047 lets the Listener deliver an admitted item as a handle: admitted and recorded, its bytes not in the guest. The round could have been given it
and its model did not read it.
Sound by §2's rule: leaving it out of consumed leaves every numerator alone and can only shrink the denominator. Conservative: a tool may resolve
the handle and read the bytes; the model still did not.
Applies to no lineage node today: every node is a Build round, and ADR-0047 labels Run's ingress and leaves Build's Read undecided.

text.tspan: §1 R6 · A round's tool list is

svg.text: ADR-0048 has the Listener deliver every tool the lease may call at the start of a round, written as the round's opening record. It is text the model read; it
enters both sets as the object that record's digest names (the custodian's decision).
Shared: every round granted the same lease shape under one bundle is given the same list, so it raises E3's exact overlap and moves a pair only toward
refusal.
Open: whether E3 sets such mechanism-rendered objects aside, or θ_exact is chosen with them in.

text.tspan: §1 R7 · An operator's lineage is declared; its root is its identity provider

svg.text: Enrolling a credential is not a Build round, so the record is declared and not projected (D-0035-1). It has no ingress, consumed, tokenizer or trainer.
E1 applies as written: two operators behind one provider are one lineage, a quorum or a pair of peers included. E2 to E5 and distillation pass
The independence table has rows for operators, read where ADR-0050 §6 asks that a peer be independent: at the archetype a different identity
provider (D-0050-2 is one provider).

R5 to R7 were written while ADR-0047, 0048 and 0050 were Proposed, and are applied in place in a record that is still Proposed. Those three records are in force since Batch 34, ADR-0050 provisional (G10 §1.1, §2.4); ADR-0035's rules for them take force only when ADR-0035 does.
Lineage strength: projected → declared (a rung-0 round in the DAG, an external base, an unbounded ingress, or an empty
consumed set)
§2's bound
No theorem: detection carries none. Voids the ability to declare archetype provenance. The tally condition is still checked, but met by declared entries resting on the author's claim
None: no participant changes type

text.tspan: ): evidence for the pipeline and the thresholds, not for the guarantee

svg.text: L-A: Llama-style, FineWeb-Edu slice, own 16k BPE · L-B: SSM or RWKV, a non-web, non-synthetic corpus such as public-domain books, own
tokenizer
Independent (E1–E5 hold)
L-A and L-A′, a fine-tune of L-A
Fail
L-A and L-C: an unfiltered FineWeb slice, of which FineWeb-Edu is a subset
Fail: the overlapping-corpora case on real data
L-A and L-D: Llama-style on the books corpus
Fail on E4 alone, while E3 passes
Two lineages on synthetic sets that name a common generator
Fail
L-T on TinyStories
Provenance rung 1 (content from GPT-3.5 and
GPT-4)
Two lineages on corpora filtered by the same classifier
Fail

The gate suite passes: every clause fires alone at least once; the relation is irreflexive, symmetric, not transitive; E3 fails closed without a measurement or with an unpinned tool; strength is weakest-link.

Overlap separates the cases by orders of magnitude, as shares: FineWeb-Edu inside a FineWeb slice 1.0000; two dumps of one filtered crawl 0.002; filtered web against books 0. Measured at 20 MB: too small to set θ.

A lineage was projected from the reference's log and matched its manifest; three tampered manifests (an omitted object, a changed seed, an injected draft) were each Contested, attributed to seat, lease and log slot. Rerun 09.28 with the same verdicts.
The records are declared: the trainer runs outside the guest.
The soundness claim was false, and the repair is a bound: holds over 2,000 trials; padding measured at 24 of 2,000 (E3) and 250 of 2,000 (distillation), declared as a residual.
Not shown: that θ is right, that the near tool is right, that independent lineages fail independently, or that the bound is how anyone else measures overlap.

text.tspan: ADR-0035 · Persona lineage is a projection of the Build log, and independence is an exclusion rule over it
